build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places a ball and jar in a physics scene
create_dynamic_jar: create a dynamic jar object with configurable scale and horizontal position in the scene
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object positioned at a specific x coordinate near the top of the scene
update_task_relationships: update the task to require placing the ball inside the jar using spatial relationships
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to indicate a single object solution tier
